51501293.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to recombinant NAMPT (unknown origin) assessed as dissociation constant by isothermal titration calorimetry

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - ITC Measurements: A MicroCal PEAQ-ITC calorimeter was used to measure the thermodynamic parameters of the combination of NAT and NAMPT. The purified NAMPT protein was concentrated in an Amicon 10 kD centrifugal filter (Merck Millipore) against the binding buffer (50 mM Tris pH 8.0, 200 mM NaCl, 1 mM TCEP, 1 mM MgCl2) to a final concentration of 200 μM. The ultrafiltrate was then used to prepare 20 μM NAT solution. Titration was performed in reverse mode by injecting NAMPT into NAT solution. Temperature was pre-set to 30 °C and injection interval was set to 150 s. The reference power of the instrument was set to 10 μCal/sec. The data were analyzed using MicroCal PEAQ-ITC Analysis Software.
original_paragraph.Results - 2.5 ITC assay: To understand the interactions between compound 72 and NAMPT, ITC assay and molecular docking were performed (Fig. 5). In the ITC assay, 72 showed a Kd value of 132 nM, which is nearly two-fold lower than that of NAT (Kd = 379 nM). This result is in agreement with the in vitro data (NAT: EC50 = 5.7 μM, 72: EC50 = 2.6 μM).
original_paragraph.Figure 5 caption: Fig. 5. Analogue 72 is more potent than NAT. (A) ITC binding curves for 72 and NAMPT. (B) ITC binding curves for NAT and NAMPT.
original_paragraph.Figure 5 - Data from thermograms: Figure 5A shows the ITC thermogram for 72 and NAMPT. The upper panel displays the raw heat flow (DP, μW) over time (min), showing a series of exothermic peaks as 72 is injected into the NAMPT solution. The lower panel shows the integrated heat (ΔH, kJ/mol) as a function of the molar ratio of 72 to NAMPT, forming a sigmoidal binding isotherm. Figure 5B shows the corresponding data for NAT and NAMPT, with a similar thermogram and binding isotherm, but with a less pronounced binding curve, indicating lower affinity.
original_paragraph.Table 7: Table 7 provides pharmacokinetic data for NAT and 72, but does not contain ITC data.

assay_conditions.buffer_composition: 50 mM Tris, 200 mM NaCl, 1 mM TCEP, 1 mM MgCl2
